ranking_source.name: WIREBENCH desk
ranking_source.title: DESK-10 — standing beats, not a computed ranking
ranking_source.note: Order is editorial: which desks a wire would staff first. The NOW line on each card is the latest matching public RSS item. It is not a judgment that the story is the most important on earth.

desks.name: WORLD
desks.summary: The foreign desk. Wars, diplomacy, and the stories that do not start in Washington or Austin.

desks.name: NATION
desks.summary: The US national desk. Congress, the White House, agencies, and the federal story of the day.

desks.name: TEXAS
desks.summary: The state desk. Austin, Houston, the border, the grid, and whatever the Lege is doing this week.

desks.name: WAR
desks.summary: Armed conflict and the Pentagon line. Separate from WORLD so a strike does not bury a famine.

desks.name: MONEY
desks.summary: Markets, the Fed, trade, and the price of everything. A wire without a money desk is a newsletter.

desks.name: ENERGY
desks.summary: Oil, gas, LNG, nuclear, and the Texas grid. This QTH lives on that story whether it wants to or not.

desks.name: SCIENCE
desks.summary: Labs, climate, public health, and the papers that escape the journals.

desks.name: COURTS
desks.summary: Indictments, injunctions, SCOTUS, and the cases that move from filing to front page.

desks.name: SPACE
desks.summary: NASA, commercial crew, and whatever just left the pad. The only desk that is allowed to be earnest.

desks.name: PRESS
desks.summary: The desk about the desk. Journalists, platforms, and the conditions under which a wire can still exist.
